title: My Dog Came Home… Wrong (Part 2) #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story from Creepyville. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Last time, your missing dog came home. And stood on two legs.
You don't sleep. You sit in the kitchen with every light on.
Bruno sits across from you. Wagging. Smiling. Too much.
In the morning, your phone rings. It's the animal shelter.
"Good news! We found your dog. Bruno. He's here, safe."
You look at the dog in your kitchen.
He stops wagging.
"Sorry," you whisper into the phone. "Which dog did you say?"
"Bruno. Brown, red collar. He's been with us for two days."
The dog in your kitchen stands up. On two legs.
He walks to the counter, takes your car keys, and holds them out.
"Let's go get him," he says. In your voice.
You drive to the shelter. He sits in the front seat with his seatbelt on.
The worker brings out the real Bruno, who goes wild with joy.
You turn around to explain.
*The front seat is empty. Only the seatbelt, still clicked shut.
That night, both of you sleep fine. Bruno snores. You smile.
Then, from the kitchen, you hear the fridge open.
And a voice, in your voice, says, "We're out of milk."
What would you have done?
Tell me in the comments, and follow for more stories from Creepyville.
